name: Assistant Agent
description: A chat assistant that drives PlotJuggler through the plugin SDK: lists and describes topics and objects (point clouds, scene entities...), reads series statistics and evaluates computations over objects, and creates derived timeseries, objects, markers, plot tabs and 3D/2D scene views it owns. Uses the Claude Code or Codex CLI already installed and signed in on your machine; the plugin stores no API keys. Linux, macOS and Windows.
author: PlotJuggler Team
